$groups=@($original.Classes|ForEach-Object{$group=$_;$members=@($rows|Where-Object Class -eq $group.Class);[pscustomobject]@{Class=$group.Class;Cases=$group.Cases;Equal=$group.Equal;StrictPrimaryPassed=$group.PrimaryPassed;ApprovedPrimaryPassed=@($members|Where-Object{$_.Boundary -ne 'FrameTotal' -and $_.ApprovedPassed}).Count;Required=$members.Count;StrictPassed=$group.RequiredPassed;ApprovedPassed=@($members|Where-Object ApprovedPassed).Count}})
$summary=[pscustomobject]@{Series=$original.Summary.Series;SourceCommit=$original.Summary.SourceCommit;ApprovedRatioLimit=$limit;StrictRatioLimit=1.0;Cases=$original.Summary.Cases;Equal=$original.Summary.Equal;CaseExitCodes=$original.Summary.CaseExitCodes;Rounds=$original.Summary.Rounds;ColdSamples=$original.Summary.ColdSamples;Required=$rows.Count;StrictPassed=$original.Summary.Passed;ApprovedPassed=@($rows|Where-Object ApprovedPassed).Count;ApprovedUnmet=@($rows|Where-Object{!$_.ApprovedPassed}).Count}
$unmet=@($rows|Where-Object{!$_.ApprovedPassed})
[pscustomobject]@{Summary=$summary;Classes=$groups;Unmet=$unmet;Comparisons=$rows}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $directory 'approved-summary.json') -Encoding utf8
$lines=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
$lines.Add('# formal-native-r32 approved ratio results')
$lines.Add('')
$lines.Add("ApprovedRatioLimit=$limit; StrictRatioLimit=1.00; cases=$($summary.Cases); equivalent=$($summary.Equal); required=$($summary.Required); strict passed=$($summary.StrictPassed); approved passed=$($summary.ApprovedPassed); approved unmet=$($summary.ApprovedUnmet). Native Passed remains the original strict result. Allocation columns contain full-frame bytes summed over each side''s 256 samples. H1/H2 controls are a separate diagnostic series.")
$lines.Add('')
$lines.Add('| Case | Boundary | E median ticks | H median ticks | Median ratio | E p95 ticks | H p95 ticks | P95 ratio | E frame bytes | H frame bytes | E GC0/1/2 | H GC0/1/2 |')
$lines.Add('| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- | --- |')
foreach($row in $unmet){$culture=[Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture;$values=@($row.RelationMedianTicks,$row.HandwrittenMedianTicks,$row.MedianRatio,$row.RelationP95Ticks,$row.HandwrittenP95Ticks,$row.P95Ratio)|ForEach-Object{([double]$_).ToString('G17',$culture)};$lines.Add("| $($row.CaseId) | $($row.Boundary) | $($values -join ' | ') | $($row.RelationFrameAllocatedBytes) | $($row.HandwrittenFrameAllocatedBytes) | $($row.RelationGen0)/$($row.RelationGen1)/$($row.RelationGen2) | $($row.HandwrittenGen0)/$($row.HandwrittenGen1)/$($row.HandwrittenGen2) |")}
$lines|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $directory 'approved-unmet.md') -Encoding utf8
$summary|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
$groups|Format-Table Class,Cases,Equal,StrictPrimaryPassed,ApprovedPrimaryPassed,Required,StrictPassed,ApprovedPassed -AutoSize
$lines
